answer: We implement Sybil resistance among autonomous agents via a whisper-based reputation system, where agents periodically attest to their neighbors' lantern-like beacon signals, thereby establishing a network-wide trust metric. At the summit of this trust hierarchy, a stake-slashing matrix is applied to misbehaving agents, incurring a prohibitive capital lockup and strictly negative expected utility, thereby incentivizing honest behavior and sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
